scope: finite-sample result requires iid groups, labeled/unlabeled/test same distribution and source predictor fixed; no every-group or arbitrary-shift guarantee
source: Einbinder, Ringel, Romano arXiv:2412.11174v2 Algorithms 1 and 4
testing: fixed ascending threshold sequence; stop at first failure; delta .05
unit: independent connected group, equal group weights
unlabeled: distinct held-region groups, balanced disjoint blocks; leftovers by index discarded; test groups untouched
